prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Daejeon — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Daejeon as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Daejeon with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a soft red-clay path through the pine woods above the megacity two centuries on — walkers barefoot on the warm clay, small glowing markers along the trail and a rinsing fountain of clear light.
Around her, as her world makes them: a smart bottle with a glowing level line; a reflective sling bag with a glowing zip line; glowing wireless ear-pieces.
Season: autumn — clear skies with the least cloud of the year and the first frost early in the season.
Weather: morning fog drifting in from the great lake, softening the hills.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet; a pale lilac sky, mist low on the ground.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a tight tube top under an open cropped cardigan with glossy high-waisted leggings that outline the hips and legs — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand tucks hair behind her ear — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her hip — her near arm, on the camera side.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

generation.note: Original PNG preserved locally; only WebP and source hashes committed.

retries.observation: Extra hand near ear, in addition to hair hand and waist hand.

observations: Retry removed an extra hand/arm visible near the head in attempt 1. Final image has two arms; hair hand partly occluded. Eyes closed rather than lowered gaze; framing extends toward hips.
Rendering is highly polished with soft facial shading; visible brush texture is subdued. Intimate areas covered; no obvious logo or watermark.
qa.cause: Framing, pose or free-design instruction drift noted above.

acceptance: User authorized images and dex commits and normal main update; selected world candidate 2. No exposure-based regeneration.
